title: 收摊之后
logline: 凌晨一点的夜市摊主完成收摊、洗刷、熄灯后推车回家，展现城市背面人群的日常，引出夜宵即时配送服务

shots.narrationEn: The city keeps its lights on
shots.visual: Wide shot of a night market at 1 a.m., a street food vendor packing up leftover ingredients and folding tables
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静共情，语速偏缓，“亮着灯”重音稍拖，气息沉稳如深夜旁观者的低语

shots.narrationEn: Some people are just wrapping up their work
shots.visual: Close-up of the vendor's hands scrubbing a greasy wok under running tap water, foam gathering around the rim
shots.ttsDirection: 平实略带倦意，语速平稳，“刚准备”轻读带短停，气息如劳作间隙的轻叹

shots.narrationEn: They wait till everyone else is asleep
shots.visual: Medium shot of the vendor loading all stall items onto a wheeled cart, then reaching up to turn off the string lights above his stall
shots.ttsDirection: 温柔沉郁，语速稍慢，“所有人”重音下沉，气息稍滞，如看着深夜归人默默收拾的触动

shots.narrationEn: Only then do they head home
shots.visual: Low-angle shot of the vendor pushing the loaded cart down a quiet, dimly lit alley, his figure gradually disappearing into the darkness
shots.ttsDirection: 释然柔软，语速放缓，“往家走”轻读带暖意，气息下沉又松，如跟着归人走夜路的踏实

shots.narrationEn: Your late-night snack is on its way
shots.visual: Close-up of the vendor unlocking his phone, the food delivery app interface glowing on the screen with a new order notification popping up
shots.ttsDirection: 温暖上扬，语速稍快，“赶来”重读带笑意，气息轻快，像突然递到手边的热乎夜宵的惊喜
